_comment: Headless coyopedal build of the bare ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 devkit (16MB quad flash, 8MB octal PSRAM, CH-series UART bridge, no panel, no codec). Mirrors the published esp32-s3-devkit-n16r8 except: the amoled-2.06 composable base compiles chip_bindings/audio/es8311.cpp whenever the app declares the audio capability (coyopedal always does), and that binding includes board::audio unconditionally — declaring no codec breaks the build even for a USB-host-only pedal. Same upstream gap as documented in mydocs ESP32-DOCS (still present in @geastack/targets 0.1.95). Workaround identical to the lcd-2 fork: PLACEHOLDER es8311 pins, nothing wired, amp silent; amp audio flows over USB host. Console is UART (bridge), NOT usb-serial-jtag.
